title: Exile: Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel
subtitle: Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel
theme: Judgment falls. But God promises a New Covenant written on the heart.
memoryText: I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts.
reviewQuestions: What is the New Covenant promise in Jeremiah 31?
What does the glory departing from the Temple in Ezekiel 8-11 mean?
What does Ezekiel 36-37 promise about the Spirit’s work in the New Covenant?
Who is the Son of Man in Daniel 7, and why is this title important?
psalmsNote: Laments of exile (89:38-52, 137, 79), songs of hope (85, 102, 103, 106, 107), and ten of the fifteen Songs of Ascents.
